units.label: paragraph 3
units.text: Directions: Before you view the first video segment, answer questions A and B.

units.label: paragraph 5
units.text: A) What had the Nazis, Japanese, and other Axis nations done that justified fighting a world war?

units.label: paragraph 8
units.text: B) What ideas or principles were Americans and the other Allies fighting for?

units.text: Answer questions C through E after you watch the video. Read the following questions before you watch the video, so you know what to listen for.

units.text: C) How did World War II change America?

units.text: E.) What do you think Ms. Biskupic meant when she referred to the Supreme Court and said, "They don't move in a straight line. They move in fits and starts. They have to backtrack"?
